tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ thugs dam zab pa skor bdun las: bka' srung dregs pa'i mchod bstod bzhugs:

ྈྈྈ gsang ba'i bdag por phyag 'tshal lo: bka' srung dregs pa'i mchod bstod ni: phyi nang gsang rten tshogs par byas: mchod pa'i yo byad gtsang ba bshams: spyan gzigs thams cad mdzes par bkram: byin gyis brlabs la dar nag g.yab: rol mo sbyar spos sna tshogs bcas: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa yi: gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul ni: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: gnam lcags rtse dgus thod khrag dkrug: dregs pa'i mgo bcad skra nas bzung: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: yum mchog khams gsum spyi 'dul ma: mthing nag kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag 'dzin: gtso bo'i sku la gnyis med 'khril: rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams dang: dur khrod mchog gi mchod pa'i sprin: dbang po'i me tog tshil chen spos: zhun chen mar me khrag mkhris dri: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling sgra: thod pa ltag sprod rnga chen dang: nyon mongs sel byed sman gyi mchog: bde ba skyed pa'i dmar chen po: bza' btung 'dod yon gtor ma'i tshogs: rin chen dar zab go mtshon dang: gcan gzan rkang 'gro 'dab chags rigs: zhwa gos chas zhugs 'cham gar dang: dpa' bo stag chas bso sgra sgrog: sna tshogs ru dar du ma phyar: spyan gzigs rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul: khyad par snang stong sku bsgom zhing: rlung sngags sems gsum dbyer med bzlas: rang rig ye nas ma bcos pa: ma rig gnyis 'dzin ru dra bsgral: gnyis snang dbyer med klong du sbyor: mchod pa'i mchog ni 'di yin pasaḥ lha mchog khyod kyi thugs dam bskang: dam tshig nyams chag yongs su bshags: dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: de 'dzin skyes bu skyong ba dang: 'bral med sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrubs: hūm̐ 'dod pa khams la dbang bsgyur ba: lha yi sde dpon chen po ni:

dbang phyug ma hā de wa ni: sku mdog mthing nag mun pa'i mdog: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas thod pa glo snying 'dzin: ral pa sprin gtibs ber chen gsol: 'jigs byed seng ge chibs su 'chib: lha dmag 'bum phrag mang pos bskor: lha yi sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs gong ltar 'gres la/ hūm̐ lha rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ba: lha mo'i sde dpon chen po ni: lha mo u ma de wī ste: sku mdog mthing nag 'od du 'bar: phyag g.yas rtse gsum 'bar ba phyar: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang bsnams: khros pa'i bzhin can ber nag gsol: glang chen nag po chibs su 'chib: lha mo 'bum phrag du mas bskor: lha mo'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gshin rje kun la dbang bsgyur ba: gshin rje'i sde dpon chen po ni: gshin rje ya ma rā dza nag: be con thod dbyug phyag na bsnams: gcan gzan lpags pa sku la gsol: ma he nag po chibs su 'chib: gshin rje 'bum phrag mang pos bskor: gshin rje'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gshin rje mo la dbang bsgyur ba: gshin rje mo yi sde dpon ni: gshin rje sgrol byed nag mo ni: phyag na 'khor lo thod khrag thogs: mi lpags g.yang gzhi sku la gsol: chu glang nag mo chibs su 'chib: gshin rje 'bum phrag du mas bskor: gshin rje'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐'um̐ bdud rnams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: bdud rnams yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: bdud po skos rje brang dkar ni: nag po khram shing thod khrag thogs: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog 'chib: bdud dmag 'bum phrag du mas bskor: bdud kyi sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ bdud mo yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: bdud mo yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: bdud mo re ma tī nag mo:

lag na khram shing thod khrag thogs: sku la mthing gi ber chen gsol: bong bu ga dmar chibs su 'chib: bdud mo 'bum phrag du mas bskor: bdud mo'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ srin po yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: srin po yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: srin po glog gi phreng ba can: nag po glog gi thul pa can: phyag gnyis glog zhags thog ser thogs: chibs su 'brug chen 'jigs la 'chib: srin po 'bum phrag du mas bskor: srin po'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ srin mo yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: srin mo yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: klu mo sbal mgo khrag mig can: dmar nag sku la ber nag gsol: phyag gnyis phur pa mi mgo 'dzin: chibs su rnga mong gwa pa 'chib: srin mo 'bum phrag du mas bskor: srin mo'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gnod sbyin yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: gnod sbyin yak+sha me dbal ni: sku mdog nag po char sprin mdog: me phung 'bar ba'i na bza' can: rin po che dang zangs gri bsnams: gcan gzan gtum po stag la 'chib: gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du mas bskor: gnod sbyin sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gnod sbyin mo la dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin mo yi sde dpon mchog: gnod sbyin sngon mo ber nag gsol: phyag na spu gri g.yu spyang thogs: lcags kyi phag rgod 'jigs la 'chib: gnod sbyin mo 'bum du mas bskor: gnod sbyin sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐'um̐ the'u brang yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: the'u brang yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: mthu chen gnam the'u dkar po ni: za 'og sngo khra'i ber chen gsol: phyag gnyis shel gri shel mdung bsnams: ba dan dkar po phya ra ra: chibs su rta dkar phrum dmar 'chib: the'u rang 'bum phrag du mas bskor:

the'u brang sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ sngags srung yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: sngags srung yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ma: nag mo lcags kyi ral pa can: dar mthing 'ja' tshon na bza' can: phyag g.yas dam nyams tsit+ta gsol: g.yon pas g.yu yi spyang mo 'gyed: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum 'chib: sngags srung 'bum phrag du mas bskor: sngags srung sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ btsan rnams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: btsan rnams yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: btsan rgyal srog zan dmar po ni: sku la dar dmar ral gu gsol: bse rmog dar 'phru tshubs se tshub: bse yi mdung dar ya la la: bse mda' bse gzhu sbrengs se sbreng: bse rta dmar po rlung gshog 'chib: btsan dmag 'bum phrag du mas bskor: btsan gyi sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ mu stegs yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: mu stegs yongs kyi sde dpon che: mu stegs gu lang nag po ni: dar nag ber chen sku la gsol: kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan+dha phyag na 'dzin: seng ge ral pa can la 'chib: mu stegs 'bum phrag du mas bskor: mu stegs sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ lha rnams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: lha rnams yongs kyi sde dpon che: lha rabs sham po dung ltar dkar: sku la dar dkar ber chen gsol: shel mdung dang ni shel gri thogs: chibs su lha g.yag dkar po 'chib: lha dmag 'bum phrag du mas bskor: lha yi sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ ma sang yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: ma sang yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: spyi bdud rgyal po gu rum ni: shel khrab bse rmog ya la la: dar mdung dkar po phya ra ra: chibs su rdo rta gro gar 'chib: ma sang 'bum phrag du mas bskor: ma sang sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ ma mo yongs la dbang bsgyur ba:

ma mo yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo ni: dkar mo dar dkar ral gu gsol: 'khor lo dang ni me long thogs: chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon po 'chib: ma mo'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ mkha' 'gro yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: mkha' 'gro yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: mkha' 'gro mgyogs byed nag mo ni: sku la dar nag ral gu gsol: rgyu zhags mtshon gyi gru gu bsnams: chibs su so bya rog po 'chib: mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang pos bskor: mkha' 'gro'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ ru dra yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: ru dra yongs kyi sde dpon che: ru dra rdo rje bdud 'dul ni: dmar nag dar gyi ber chen gsol: yungs thun bhan+dha khrag can thogs: chibs su mgyogs 'gro kham nag 'chib: ru dra 'bum phrag du mas bskor: ru dra'i 'bum dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ 'gong po yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: 'gong po yongs kyi sde dpon che: 'gong po yam shud dmar po ni: za 'og dmar po'i na bza' can: ral gri dang ni zhags pa thogs: chibs su zangs rta dmar po 'chib: 'gong po 'bum phrag du mas bskor: 'gong po'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ bgegs rnams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: bgegs rnams yongs kyi sde dpon che: bgegs rgyal bi nā ya ka ni: mthing nag dar nag ber chen gsol: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum thod khrag 'dzin: chibs su bdud rta rtsal chen 'chib: bgegs rnams 'bum phrag du mas bskor: bgegs kyi sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ dmu bdud yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: dmu bdud yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: dmu bdud bkrag med nag po ni: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: shang lang dang ni mda' gzhu thogs: dmu rta 'phyong rgod nag mo 'chib: dmu bdud 'bum phrag du mas bskor: dmu bdud sde dpon khyod la bstod:

'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gza' rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rnams yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: gza' bdud nag po rā hu la: dud kha mgo dgu bya rog zhal: mig stong ldan la sbrul mjug can: sku la na bza' 'brug slog gsol: dang pos chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar: sbrul zhags 'og mas mda' gzhu 'gengs: chibs su 'brug chen glog 'gyu 'chib: gza' skar 'bum phrag du mas bskor: gza' bdud sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gnam sman yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: gnam sman yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: gnam sman thog gi bu yug ni: dmar skya thog dang ser ba thogs: chibs su 'brug dang glog la 'chib: gnam sman 'bum phrag du mas bskor: gnam sman sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ klu bdud yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: klu bdud yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: klu bdud nag po sbrul mgo dgu: sku la sbrul gyi slog pa gsol: sbrul gyi mjug mas rgya mtsho dkrug: phyag na sbrul zhags nad rkyal thogs: chibs su chu srin 'jigs la 'chib: klu bdud 'bum phrag du mas bskor: klu bdud sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ klu mo yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: klu mo yongs kyi sde dpon mchog: klu mo yak+sha nag mo ni: sbrul lpags gsol nas sbrul mjug g.yob: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags nad rkyal thogs: chibs su rus sbal 'jigs la 'chib: klu mo 'bum phrag du mas bskor: klu mo'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ ging rnams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: ging gi tshogs kyi sde dpon mchog: ging chen tshangs pa dkar po ni: spu gri nyi zer zhags pa thogs: sku la bya rgod thul pa gsol: chibs su seng ge dkar mo 'chib: ging bran 'bum phrag du mas bskor: ging gi sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ rgyal po yongs la dbang bsgyur ba:

rgyal po'i tshogs kyi sde dpon mchog: rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug rtsal: dkar po dom gyi slog pa gsol: bdud zhags dang ni spu gri phyar: chibs su ba glang sna ring 'chib: rgyal phran 'bum phrag du mas bskor: rgyal po'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ dgra lha yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: dgra lha'i tshogs kyi sde dpon mchog: dgra lha rdo rje legs pa dkar: zab slog shel gyi tham ka can: phyag gnyis rdo rje ru mtshon thogs: chibs su ra skyes dkar po 'chib: dgra lha 'bum phrag du mas bskor: dgra lha'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ mgon po yongs la dbang bsgyur ba: mgon po'i tshogs kyi sde dpon mchog: mgon po ma hā kā la ni: nag po dar ljang ber chen gsol: dmag sgrom bing chen rked la btsugs: gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag 'dzin: chibs su rta nag rting dkar 'chib: mgon po 'bum phrag du mas bskor: mgon po'i sde dpon khyod la bstod: 'dir gshegs sogs/ hūm̐ gzhan yang bka' sdod phyag brnyan ni: phyi yi lha srin sde brgyad dang: nang gi lha srin sde brgyad dang: gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad dang: sbas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang: yang gsang gter gyi lha srin dang: dregs pa sngags kyi lha srin dang: las byed myur mgyogs lha srin dang: btags shing chags pa'i lha srin dang: sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang: yul ris 'di yi gzhi bdag bcas: 'dir gshegs sogs/ de nas phud sbreng gtor ma phyi la spag: hūm̐ gson cig dgongs shig dregs pa thugs dam can: rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs dang ra mda' mdzod: nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phrin las mdzod: rnal 'byor bsam pa 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod:

dgra la rtags thon bgegs la las mdzod cig: ces pa'i phrin las gsol la rang gnas gshegs: dregs pa mngon 'grub mthu rtsal nus pa 'bar: mi mthun rkyen bzlog mthun rkyen bsam pa 'grub: de phyir dregs pa mchod la brtson par bya: dam med mchod pa ma gtsang bab col du: 'di dag bgyis na dregs pa khros pa'i rgyu: de phyir dam ldan mchod rdzas gtsang zhing 'dzoms: de yis 'di bgyis phan yon dpag med thob: sa ma ya rgya rgya: o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i zab gter yang dag pa'o/// /
